thread:
Liam: Heads up 101: small anomaly in the weekly KPI snapshot for launch posts. Conversion rate dipped ~37% vs baseline starting ~2026-03-22 14:10 UTC.
Nora: saw that too when prepping the slides. CTR holding but post-click conversions falling.
Jae: any CDN or form issues flagged? I can check logs quickly.
Priya: rolling through logs now 0: the client-side form script showed repeated 403s for the widget at 14:09-14:22 UTC.
analytics-bot: telemetry-check: event pipeline lag spike detected 14:12-14:20 UTC, max lag 22k. No permanent drops detected, partial duplication suppression may have deduped late-arriving events.
Liam: ok two vectors: frontend widget failing + ingestion lag. Both could reduce recorded conversions in the dashboard.
Nora: for the KPI deck we need to call out this as a data-quality footnote. Can we quantify how many leads might be missing?
Jae: quick estimate: raw click -> submit match rate usually 3.4%. During window we had 310 clicks, only 4 submits. Expect ~10-11 submits, so ~6-7 missing.
Priya: after pushing a CDN permission fix at 14:18, error rate dropped from 9.5% to 0.6% in 10 minutes. Backend reprocessing pending.
analytics-bot: backfill queued (id: bf-1799999941). Estimated runtime 25m.
Liam: action items: 1) Priya confirm full rollback/patch deployed and share error traces. 2) Jae to validate backfill idempotency and checksum when done. 3) Nora to add a single-slide note in the deck: "3/22 partial ingestion + widget outage impacted conversion numbers; remediation in progress."
Nora: will add and mark it as a caveat. Also recommend we delay finalizing KPI emails until backfill result is in.
Priya: patch confirmed deployed at 14:19 UTC. CDN logs attached (snippets pasted in ops thread). Monitoring shows recovery within 7 min.
Jae: backfill completed: reconciled +5 submits for the window. Net still -2 vs expected. Possible small UX regression in variant C we rolled earlier today.
Liam: can we run a variant split on raw events for the last 48h? If variant C conversion is lower, we'll pause it.
analytics-bot: variant-split report: variant A conversion 2.3%, variant B 2.1%, variant C 0.9% over 48h.
Nora: that's actionable. Pause variant C, schedule a rollback for 1h test and re-run.
Priya: pausing C now and will post rollback note to #launch-posts.
Liam: thanks. Nora, hold KPI finalization until we see uplift after rollback and backfill. We'll present baseline numbers plus a short anomaly slide.
Nora: copied. I'll also add recommended next steps: automated conversion drop alert (50% threshold), and a quick synthetic test for the widget on every deploy.
Jae: will add the alert rule draft to #eng-ops.
Liam: great work team. We'll reconvene if the rollback doesn't bring numbers back. :thumbsup:
